pre_date_header: SR. AI/DATA ENGINEER | Agnie Consulting (Client: Abcam Limited, UK)
bullets: Engineered production-grade, multi-tenant AI lead-generation solutions on AWS Fargate using Python, Snowflake and Terraform, reducing onboarding time for global business units by ~75% o Delivered Salesforce-ready data (SFDC) enabling direct lead activation, conversion tracking, and analytics

Architected and packaged a reusable AI lead scoring framework in Python, exposing a unified interface adopted across multiple AI lead-generation applications o Versioned and distributed via GitLab CI pipelines to enable controlled releases and consistent rollout

Designed an agentic AI system hosted on MCP server to autonomously discover, qualify, and ingest tender data from external websites using keyword-driven filtering, enabling sales teams to query and derive insights

Improved system efficiency by creating pipeline to integrate diverse data sources (CSVs, JSONs, APIs) into BigQuery database with 150M+ rows for real estate enrichment analysis using SQL and Python transformations

Developed and deployed SaaS solution using AI/LLM techniques to summarize email interaction between users o Implemented a monitoring and caching system, significantly reducing operational AI costs and improving observability and response times for data summarization.

Created ML-based investment strategy model using 50+ parameters, achieving consistent returns in back test o Implemented robust algorithmic trading code in Python to paper trade the strategy in Indian equity market o Automated tracking dashboard for strategy using Streamlit and Google Sheets to analyse the trades analytics

Orchestrated implementation of chatbot leveraging LLMs to streamline interactions with structured data o Developed and curated training datasets to fine-tune OpenAI GPT-3.5 for chatbot’s conversational module o Engineered robust ETL pipelines, transforming data from Redshift SQL to Elasticsearch on AWS infrastructure o Executed RAG model for semantic caching, optimizing data retrieval efficiency and responsiveness in product o Implemented template-based responses & data manipulating techniques, resulting in 6x faster bot response

Performed historical analysis on algorithmic trading strategies to finetune technical parameters, aiming to enhance annualized returns while minimizing max drawdown for a trading strategy. o Enhanced trading analysis by shifting codebase from Python to C++, reducing the execution time by 80%

Built API endpoint using social media data integration with robust validation tailored for underwriting purposes o Implemented LLM-based and web scraping frameworks to target incumbent B2B SaaS product services o Constructed a LinkedIn data pipeline with prioritization algorithms for high-profile contact outreach for client
Organized and led a python training on Linear Regression and Logistic Regression to improve team capabilities
Recognized with an A+ (highest rating), for outstanding performance, being the sole recipient in the joining batch
